mostWorthwhile.text: Restoring the water line was most worthwhile: warming and checking it before opening the inlet made the recovery sequence physically meaningful.

leastWorthwhile.text: Powering the return plant felt like a routine intermediate step, especially as the only gameplay option.

surprise.text: The plant's feed stayed closed after power returned, making clear that cooling and water readiness were separate restart requirements.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the restart steps had clear purposes, although most choices were dictated by the available options.

continue.text: I would continue to see what happens to the ice-core discovery and return journey, though this chapter's largely predetermined recovery was more procedural than surprising.
